title: Manganese/Cerium Clusters Spanning a Range of Oxidation Levels and CeMn8, Ce2Mn4, and Ce6Mn4 Nuclearities: Structural, Magnetic, and EPR Properties

material_class.structural_family: Ce6 octahedron face-fused with two [Mn2Ce2O4] cubanes

synthesis.procedure: Aerobic synthesis. Method A: [Mn12O12(O2CMe)16(H2O)4] (0.50 g, 0.25 mmol) in MeCN (20 mL) treated with solid (NH4)2[Ce(NO3)6] (0.28 g, 0.50 mmol), stirred 30 min (dark brown to red-brown), filtered, layered with pyridine (5 mL), and left 10 d at room temperature to give black needles of 1·2py·6MeCN; crystals kept in mother liquor for X-ray, otherwise filtered, washed with Et2O, and dried under vacuum. Method B (higher yield): same reagents in MeCN (15 mL)/pyridine (10 mL), stirred 15 min, filtered, and left 3 d; product identical by elemental analysis, IR, and unit cell.
synthesis.time: Method A: 30 min stir then 10 d crystallization; Method B: 15 min stir then 3 d crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution reaction; filtration then layering (A) or standing (B)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; Method A layered with pyridine; black needles of 1·2py·6MeCN; washed with Et2O and dried under vacuum for solid-state studies
synthesis.yield: 20% based on Ce (Method A); 40% based on Ce (Method B)

properties.summary: Predominantly antiferromagnetic exchange. DC data for 1 fit as a dinuclear MnIII–MnIV pair with J = −60.4(7) cm−1 and g = 2.00(1) (H = −2J Si·Sj), giving an S = 1/2 ground state. Variable-temperature DC/AC magnetization studied over 5.0–300 K.

measurements.name: exchange coupling J
measurements.conditions: fit of DC susceptibility; isotropic Hamiltonian H = -2J Si·Sj; dinuclear MnIII MnIV model

synthesis.procedure: The picoline analogue 1' is obtained in comparable yield by the same method as 1 using picoline instead of pyridine. It is significantly more soluble in common solvents than 1. Elemental analysis reported for 1'·2H2O.

synthesis.vessel_or_method: same aerobic procedure as 1 with picoline replacing pyridine

material_class.structural_family: CeMn8 saddlelike Mn8 loop about central CeIV

synthesis.procedure: Aerobic. To a stirred solution of [Mn8O2(O2CCH2tBu)14(tBuCH2CO2H)4] (0.70 g, 0.25 mmol) in DMF (30 mL) was slowly added solid (NH4)2[Ce(NO3)6] (0.28 g, 0.50 mmol). Stirred 30 min (red-brown to dark brown), filtered, and crystallized (Markdown crystallization sentence is truncated). Isolated yield 40% at Ce/Mn = 1:4. Use of Ce(ClO4)4 instead of CAN also gave 2 in comparable yield.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic DMF solution reaction then filtration
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solution filtered after color change; crystals of 2 (Markdown omits later workup details)

properties.summary: Predominantly antiferromagnetic coupling. DC and AC data indicate an S = 0 ground state, unprecedented for the CeMn8 family, so that family now spans S = 0 to the maximum S = 16.

material_class.structural_family: [Ce2Mn4] octahedron with CeIII on either side of a Mn4 parallelogram

synthesis.procedure: Reaction of (NH4)2[Ce(NO3)6], Mn(O2CMe)2·4H2O, and hmpH in a 1:1:1 ratio in MeCN gave a dark red-brown solution from which 3 was isolated in 60% yield. Product is CeIII2MnIII4. Attempts with Ce(ClO4)4 or other carboxylates did not give clean products. Markdown does not preserve individual masses beyond the 1:1:1 ratio.
